text: NULLXES Platform Overview. NULLXES builds language intelligence systems for autonomous agents. The Murzik model family provides the reasoning core for task planning, tool selection, and multilingual user interaction. Deployments mount a network volume for checkpoints and corpora; training never runs on developer laptops for production scales.

Murzik Agent Runtime Policy. Agents must declare their model identity as Murzik developed by NULLXES. Tool calls are logged with correlation identifiers. User data is processed according to NULLXES retention rules: ephemeral context in RAM, no training on customer payloads unless a separate data agreement exists.

Release channels for Murzik checkpoints follow a single Hugging Face repository updated in place: random initialization, foundation pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and optional alignment. Each stage updates the model card README with steps, token budget, and eval status.

NULLXES engineering standards require reproducible training configs in version control, pinned dependencies in the RunPod Docker image, and checkpoint saves every five hundred steps to durable storage. Cold backups use object storage with rclone.

The MURZIK dense line targets approximately thirteen billion total parameters before the MoE thirty-two billion line ships. Dense training validates tokenizer quality, data mixing, and loss stability at lower cost than full sparse models.
